title: Compact Compass: Workspace Layers & Route Consolidation
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Goal: Simplify the Console left rail and workspace switching experience by introducing a compact, layered navigation metaphor (the 'Compass') that reduces cognitive load for multi-tenant users and surfaces rollout and cost telemetry more contextually.

Background: Current feedback shows customers struggle to find per-workspace rollout controls and cost breakdowns when they have many projects/workspaces. The Console's existing sidebar mixes global and workspace-scoped routes, leading to duplicated targets and hidden rollouts. This ticket scopes a design spike + high-fidelity prototype to validate an IA that: (1) consolidates routing into hierarchical layers, (2) introduces a compact, collapsible workspace lens, and (3) surfaces rollout state and cost deltas inline.

Scope & Deliverables:
- Deliver a high-fidelity Figma prototype of the Compact Compass pattern for desktop and responsive narrow-width layouts.
- Define route taxonomy and mapping for migrateable routes (list of routes that move into layers vs remain global).
- Interaction spec for workspace switching: hover preview, inline search, keyboard nav.
- UX spec for rollout and cost micro-panels: when to show summary vs deep-link to Console Rollouts/Cost pages.
- Accessibility checklist: keyboard-only flows, ARIA roles for nested lists, contrast checks for compact mode.
- Acceptance criteria and A/B test plan for canary rollout.

Design decisions & trade-offs considered:
- Compactness vs discoverability: the Compass compresses labels into icon+micro-labels to save vertical real estate; we include hover previews and a persistent search to aid discovery.
- Route consolidation vs cognitive mapping: some tenants expect top-level access to Model Catalog and Jobs. We propose a "pin" affordance that can lift 1–2 routes to the top level per workspace.
- Inline telemetry vs noise: rollout and cost deltas will only surface when there is a non-zero delta or active rollout to avoid clutter.

Success metrics:
- Reduce time-to-target route by 25% in usability test (scenarios: open rollout, inspect cost for workspace, start a canary).
- Reduce accidental route duplication across workspaces by 90% in migration test.
- Positive sentiment: 80% of participants rate navigation 'clear' or 'very clear'.

Notes & references:
- Prototype in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE/compact-compass-prototype
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/CONSOLE/Compass+Navigation+PRD
